testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.combat.CombatEngageTests

testcase.name: flat +-14 combat level range blocks a fight when the gap exceeds 14
an owner cannot attack their own familiar and an opponent cannot attack one in single combat
players can fight in dangerous wilderness within the flat +-14 combat level range
Ferox outside the bank can fight the Wilderness side of a barrier
a player protected by the post-kill grace period cannot be attacked
postAttack arms the combat-escape logout lock on the target
an opponent can attack a public familiar in multi combat even without an Attack cache option
players can fight in Ferox outside the bank
flat +-14 combat level range applies at exactly the boundary
an ordinary non attackable npc remains blocked for a player
flat +-14 combat level range also applies outside the Wilderness since PvP is dangerous everywhere
